senses.gloss: Remaining; left behind; extra; odd; in reserve.
Becoming evident after a relatively long time period.
To exhale (the breath) in sighs.
Of or pertaining to the esophagus.
The tube that carries food from the pharynx to the stomach.
The day immediately before today; one day ago.

English-language; of or pertaining to the language, descended from Anglo-Saxon, which developed in England.

A native or inhabitant of England; a man who is English by ancestry, birth, descent, or naturalisation. [from 7th c.]
An inhabitant of Great Britain, particularly (historical) a Celt from the area of Roman Britain or (obsolete) a Welshman; a British person.
A person from England or of English descent.
(Scotland, pejorative) An English person.
The state of being intoxicated or drunk.
Any large outdoor light used to illuminate a public area, usually urban.
The pole that holds up a light so it can illuminate a wide area, such as holds up a streetlight.
Usually solid excretory product evacuated from the bowels; feces.
(slang, mildly, vulgar) Expression of worry, fear, shock, surprise, disgust, annoyance, or dismay.
(chiefly, North America, colloquial, mildly, vulgar, especially with "feel") Bad, sick, or depressed.
(chiefly, UK, Irish, vulgar) An expression of annoyance or dismay.
(colloquial, countable) A worthless, despicable person.
Digested waste material (typically solid or semi-solid) discharged from a human or other mammal's stomach to the intestines.
(informal, mildly, vulgar) A piece of solid feces.
(slang, offensive, or, derogatory, vulgar) A stupid, obnoxious, or undesirable person.
catlike (resembling a cat); sleek, graceful, inscrutable, sensual, and/or cunning.
A route or proposed route of a journey.
An organism that is not an animal, especially an organism capable of photosynthesis, and typically a small or herbaceous organism of this kind, rather than a tree.
A building or campus specially designed for a specific purpose, such as incarceration, military use, or scientific experimentation.
Any plant.
Of, pertaining to, or connected with flowers.
A short, erect tail, as of a hare, rabbit, or deer.
The weight or mass of an organism.
An industrial solvent, often containing polyhalogenated hydrocarbons, used to remove grease from mechanical parts.
A short-horned goat antelope native to mountainous terrain in southern Europe; Rupicapra rupicapra.
A type of wild mountain goat of the genus Capra, such as the species Capra ibex.
The decision or judgement of a jury or court; a verdict.
The act of judging.
A decision on an issue of fact in a civil or criminal case or an inquest.
(intransitive, transitive, sports) To serve as umpire or referee.
(transitive) To decide, rule on, or settle as a judge.
Any of the collections of many millions or billions of stars, galactic dust, black holes, etc. existing as independent and coherent systems, of which there are billions in the known universe.
(countable, uncountable) amount of space between points
At a distance, far away.
A person who owns land.

The cardinal number immediately following fifty-one and preceding fifty-three.

Considering; taking into account.

To be very hungry.

(hematology, pathology) A blood clot formed from platelets and other elements that forms in a blood vessel in a living organism, and causes thrombosis or obstruction of the vessel at its point of formation or travel to other areas of the body.
Related to the European Union.
A North American marten-like mammal (Pekania pennanti), that has thick brown fur.
To a great extent; in essence; essentially.

(geography) The subfield of geography that studies physical patterns and processes of the Earth. It aims to understand the forces that produce and change rocks, oceans, weather, and global flora and fauna patterns.
A telephone call.
A bell, buzzer, or chime device mounted on or adjacent to a door's exterior, meant to be rung by a visitor to announce one's presence.
A small particle; a speck.
Jurisprudence in the Islamic law, shari'a.
A device (transducer) used to convert sound waves into a varying electric current; normally fed into an amplifier and either recorded or transmitted over radio.
The part of a telephone that is held close to the mouth.
A weight class in boxing and other sports, intermediate between flyweight and featherweight. In boxing it ranges from 112 to 118 pounds (51 to 54 kg).
A perennial herb of the genus Onobrychis with pale pink flowers, especially Onobrychis viciifolia (syn. Onobrychis sativa).
An invertebrate animal of the phylum Arthropoda, characterized by a chitinous exoskeleton and multiple jointed appendages.
Of or pertaining to one's father, his genes, his relatives, or his side of a family.
Kind, genial, benevolent, or tolerant.
A chemical compound created to have the same effect.
An observation tower in which a lookout keeps watch over prisoners, or looks out for fires, etc.
A sound or action like liquid hitting a hard surface, or an object falling into a body of water.
A cord formed by spinning or twisting together textile fibers or filaments into one or more continuous strands, typically used in needlework.
(figuratively) Any influence by which persons are caught, held, or drawn, as if by a cord.
Each of the strings which, twisted together, make up a yarn, rope or cord.
A twisted strand of fibre used for knitting or weaving.
A fine thread or wire.
Thread used to sew or stitch two edges (especially of skin) together.
Absolute; without conditions, limitations, reservations or qualifications.
Absolute; having no exception.
That property of a body by which it occupies a portion of space (or time, e.g. "spatiotemporal extension").
A straggling, haphazard growth, especially of housing on the edge of a city.
A snack food made from corn or maize kernels popped by dry heating.
A container.

A member of a criminal or street gang.

A gangster; a hired thug.
One who commits crimes (especially fraud, bribery, loansharking, extortion etc.) to aid in running a shady or illegal business.
Frightening; causing fear.

In an indiscriminate manner.
Made up of various disparate elements mixed together; of disorderly composition.
Random; chaotic; incomplete; not thorough, constant, or consistent.
In a haphazard manner; in a random, chaotic, and incomplete manner.
Habitual moderation in regard to the indulgence of the natural appetites and passions; restrained or moderate indulgence.
An animal that leads.
Something which is believed to possess, contain, or cause spiritual or magical powers; an amulet or a talisman.
Relating to technology.
A time limit in the form of a date on or before which something must be completed.
A record or narrative description of past events.

In the International System of Units, the base unit of amount of substance; the amount of substance of a system which contains exactly 6.02214076×10²³ elementary entities (atoms, ions, molecules, etc.). Symbol: mol. The number of atoms is known as Avogadro’s number.
An article of clothing worn over the front of the torso and/or legs for protection from spills; also historically worn by Freemasons and as part of women's fashion.
An item of clothing for people (especially babies) tied around their neck to protect their clothes from getting dirty when eating.
A sleeveless dress, often similar to an apron, generally worn over other clothes, and most often worn by young girls as an overdress.
(board games) A portable surface marked for playing a game, and on which the counters or other pieces are placed and moved.
One who teaches another (usually called a student, learner, or tutee) in a one-on-one or small-group interaction.
A slate or enamel board for writing on with chalk; a predecessor to a whiteboard.
An aristocrat; one of aristocratic blood.
One of the aristocracy, nobility, or people of rank in a community; one of a ruling class; a noble (originally in Revolutionary France).
A pleasing combination of elements, or arrangement of sounds.
A state of agreement; harmony; union.
Endowed with one or more talents.
Endowed with special, in particular intellectual, abilities.
Good at something; skilled; fluent; practiced, especially in relation to a task or skill.
A property, attribute or ability which gives one a superiority or advantage over others; an inherent advantage or privilege; a talent.
Of or relating to faculty, especially to mental faculty.
An unborn or unhatched vertebrate showing signs of the mature animal.

The office or jurisdiction of an admiral.

The portion of an architectural entablature situated between the architrave and the cornice, consisting of a flat surface that may be continuous or articulated by triglyphs and is often decorated with sculptural figures and ornamental details.
An act of stretching.
A political doctrine or philosophy that proposes that the rights and powers of ordinary people are exploited by a privileged elite, and supports their struggle to overcome this.

Confidence in one's own worth; self-respect.

The lowest and supporting part or member of a wall, including the base course and footing courses; in a frame house, the whole substructure of masonry.
Go away! Clear off!

A fretted stringed instrument, similar to the guitar, having a bowl-shaped body or soundbox; any of a wide variety of chordophones with a pear-shaped body and a neck whose upper surface is in the same plane as the soundboard, with strings along the neck and parallel to the soundboard.
One who suffers greatly or constantly, even involuntarily.

One who perpetrates; especially, one who commits an offence or crime.

Annoying, troublesome, irritating (usually of an animal or child).
Unpleasant.
Harsh and rough-sounding.
Causing repugnance; unpleasant to the feelings or senses; displeasing.

Consisting of, or resembling, granules or grains.
